Update 11/15:

AirPods Pro 3 have dropped to Black Friday pricing early at $179 shipped (Reg. $249)

All Apple Watch Series 12 models have hit Amazon all-time lows at $70 off. 

Alongside the release of the new Apple TV 4K, we also have loads of the early Black Friday offers flying with the lowest prices to date on AirTag 2 at $17.50, rare discounts on Magic Mouse, the lowest price yet on the 2026 Magic Keyboard and more, alongside the $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3. 

This week’s impressive $250 price drops on M5 MacBook Air are also joined by M6 Mac mini at up to $150 off, the best prices to date on Apple Watch Ultra 4 at nearly $100 off, the iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil USB-C, chargers, official Apple iPhone 18 Pro cases, and more. Check it all out below.
